Rekomendasi Stack untuk zul CLI Tool
Berdasarkan analisis di atas, inilah recommended stack untuk membuat tool seperti zul:

# pyproject.toml [build-system] requires = ["hatchling"] build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]

dependencies = [

"typer[all]>=0.9.0",

# CLI framework (includes

"copier>=9.0.0",

# Template engine

"inquirerpy>=0.3.4",

# Interactive prompts

"jinja2>=3.1.0",

# Template rendering

"pydantic-settings>=2.0.0", # Config management

]

Rich)

Why this stack?
Modern: Semua tools actively maintained dan follow latest standards[4] [10] [19] [25] [43] Type-safe: Typer + Pydantic Settings memberikan full type safety [3] [4] [37] Beautiful: Rich (via Typer) + InquirerPy = professional CLI UX [24] [26] [27] Future-proof: Copier support template updates, critical untuk long-term maintenance[8] [10]
[12]
Industry standard: Jinja2 + Hatch widely adopted di industri[43] [44] [32] Hindari: PyInquirer (unmaintained), Cookiecutter (no updates), Argparse (too verbose), Colorama (too basic), Setuptools (too complex)[19] [43] [28] .
